title: getlogisticsdashboardrecentbookings
description: Verify that GET /logistics returns a dashboard view with recent bookings for an authenticated user.

title: getlogisticsmanagebookingslistview
description: Verify that GET /logistics/manage returns the bookings management view listing all bookings for an authenticated user.

title: postlogisticsajaxdatatablebookingslist
description: Verify that POST /logistics/ajax-datatable returns a 200 response with a paginated and searchable bookings dataset for an authenticated user.

title: postlogisticsdeletebookingvalidid
description: Verify that POST /logistics/delete/{id} with a valid booking id atomically deletes the booking and all related child shipment items and returns a 200 response.

title: postlogisticsdeletebookinginvalidid
description: Verify that POST /logistics/delete/{id} with an invalid or missing booking id returns an error response and does not delete any booking.

title: gettrackinghistorybookingid
description: Verify that GET /tracking/history/{booking_id} returns a 200 response with chronological tracking history for the specified booking id for an authenticated user.

title: posttrackingsavevaliddata
description: Verify that POST /tracking/save with valid booking_id, status, location, event date/time, and optional POD file saves a new or updates an existing tracking record and returns a 200 response.

title: posttrackingsaveinvaliddata
description: Verify that POST /tracking/save with missing or invalid required tracking fields returns an error response and does not commit any tracking record.

title: posttrackingdeletevalidid
description: Verify that POST /tracking/delete/{id} with a valid tracking record id permanently deletes the tracking record and returns a 200 response.

title: postmastersajaxdatatablevalidtype
description: Verify that POST /masters/ajax-datatable/{type} with a valid master type and search/pagination parameters returns a 200 response with a paginated master listing for an authenticated user.
